limits: Observed reception has no denominator for unreceived vessels; silence is not absence or a diagnosed outage.
Research grid thresholds are provisional discovery choices, not C-CORE requirements or statistical sufficiency.
Grid cells have unequal physical area; report density per square kilometre is not inferred.
Shortlisted cells are proposals, not reservations or training labels. Whole-cell and candidate-envelope roles are checked separately.
Tracks are aligned before spatial filtering; tight support uses catalogue midpoint and 120-second nearest / 240-second brackets.
Native target-time brackets, competing identities, physical water, native processing and permitted use remain admission requirements.
Adjacent slices, repeated identities, many messages and multiple cells do not create independent examples.
No scientific reviewer, accuracy truth, model scoring, promotion or physical object confirmation is supplied.
